name: opencompress-studio
description: Local browser-based batch image compressor with optional reSmush.it API support.

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && node node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js build
scripts.clean: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); for (const p of ['dist','node_modules','.opencompress']) if (fs.existsSync(p)) fs.rmSync(p,{recursive:true,force:true});"
